title: Yellowy Smoky Indian Eggplant Baingan Bharta
description: A winey, chewy, and comforting Indian dish featuring roasted eggplant, served with a bun on a cedar plank, perfect for a sick day. This Goan-inspired recipe is onion and garlic friendly, with a smoky flavor from the air fryer.

ingredients.name: eggplant
ingredients.notes: any variety, but purple works best

ingredients.name: bun
ingredients.notes: any type, but lightly toasted works best

instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Poke some holes in the eggplants and roast them in the air fryer for 30 minutes, or until the skin is charred and the flesh is soft.
Let the eggplants cool down, then peel and chop them into small pieces.
In a large bowl, mix together the chopped eggplant, diced tomato, green chili, cilantro, lemon juice, smoked paprika, and salt.
Toast the buns lightly and slice them in half.
Spoon the eggplant mixture onto the buns and serve on a cedar plank.
Garnish with additional cilantro and lemon wedges if desired.
